provenance.polyDegree: Taken directly from the searched N. This is search output.

provenance.securityLevel: Derived by thresholding the estimator output (searched.estimatorBits >= 192 ? 192 : 128). Not from a lattice attack cost model, and not a bit-security claim.
provenance.lweDimension: Hardcoded ladder lookup on N in estimateLweDimension. Not a search result and not derived from any security analysis.
provenance.lweNoiseStd: searched.sigma / 1000. The genome stores sigma as an integer scaled by 1000 (see genome.ts), so this is the decoded searched sigma rather than a heuristic — but it is applied here as the GLWE/LWE noise std with no calibration step, so treat the role it plays as unvalidated.
provenance.glweDimension: Fixed constant 1. Not searched, not derived.
provenance.decompBaseLog: Heuristic: round(log2(Bg)) in estimateDecomposition. Derived from the searched Bg but not itself searched or benchmarked.
provenance.decompLevel: Heuristic: step function of Bg in estimateDecomposition (3 / 2 / 1 at the Bg = 16 and Bg = 128 breakpoints). Not searched or benchmarked.
